capabilities: Add a header with language badge, icon, and optional title to fenced code blocks
Copy or download the exact code from a block without fences or line numbers
Show line numbers without changing the underlying code
Collapse or add vertical scrolling to long code blocks with configurable thresholds
Independently disable each header control and feature in settings
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. Mermaid, Dataview, and DataviewJS blocks are intentionally left to their own processors.
problem: Obsidian renders fenced code blocks bare, with no visible language label, no one-click copy or download, and no way to keep very long blocks readable.
summary: Code-block enhancer that adds a theme-aware header with language badge, block title, copy and download actions, plus line numbers, scrolling, and collapse.
